existingReportSummary.executiveSummaryMd: `DomainResource` keeps its identity and local content model, with no local element removals or cardinality/type narrowing. The main concerns are changed summary serialization for `modifierExtension`, the rewritten `dom-3` contained-resource invariant, and semantic text changes for contained resources. Confidence is medium because official diffs, invariant test cases, and narrative pages were not available.
existingReportSummary.migrationThemesMd: Migration work should focus on validator and serializer behavior rather than structural data transforms. Existing instances that use `text`, `contained`, `extension`, or `modifierExtension` remain structurally representable, but summary-mode APIs and contained-resource validation should be regression-tested. Cross-version conversion should also document policy for R6 contained resources that are `Parameters` or R6-only/additional resource types.
existingReportSummary.confidenceSummaryMd: Confidence is high for direct computable deltas in the two StructureDefinitions: identity, cardinality, types, slicing, flags, and local constraints were compared. Confidence is medium for semantic impact because the supplied inputs did not include official change notes, normative narrative pages, or conformance test cases proving whether the `dom-3` expression rewrite is behaviorally equivalent.
